limitations: The posterior measures historical calibration uncertainty, not every source of matchup error.
Long five-round totals have fewer completed fights and therefore wider uncertainty.
This policy is paper-only until it has enough prospective settlements.

0.5.reason: The Bayesian adjustment made probability accuracy worse on the later-fight check, so it is not used for staking.

staking_rule.description: Kelly at the lower 10th percentile of the calibrated chance, capped at 5% of bankroll
